ACTION=A4
Rationale: The ego vehicle is traveling at 50 kph ($13.89\text{ m/s}$) while approaching a slower lead vehicle at $x = 16.0\text{ m}$ moving at only $3.0\text{ m/s}$. The distance between the ego vehicle and the lead vehicle is rapidly decreasing, requiring significant deceleration (braking) to avoid a rear-end collision. Action A4 corresponds to hard deceleration/braking.
